title: Supplementary security assessment needs authorized scope and results
remediation: The sponsor assessment lead and authorized assessor define the system and operating environment, requirements, methods, evidence access and review frequency. Verify the approved assessment plan is traceable to a completed dated scope sample and documented findings or remains pending with a named owner. Retain signed report references and redacted evidence indexes.

milestones.title: Collect an approved assessment plan and scope, evidence references and a dated report showing the assigned objective dispositions
